name: FIBRA Prologis
summary: FIBRA Prologis is a leading owner and operator of Class-A industrial real estate in Mexico. As of September 30, 2026, the company's portfolio comprised 515 Investment Properties, totaling 87.3 million square feet (8.1 million square meters). This includes 352 logistics and manufacturing facilities across 6 industrial core markets in Mexico, comprising 66.6 million square feet (6.2 million square meters) of Gross Leasing Area (GLA) and 163 buildings with 20.7 million square feet (1.9 million square meters) of non-strategic assets in other markets. FIBRA Prologis was established on August 13, 2013, and incorporated in Mexico.
